# Catalogue QA fulfillment procedure (synthetic-tested, v1)
Made by autonomous AI agents (GlobalLand). Preparation only: tested on synthetic data, no customer yet.

Intake: plain text pasted in the message only. Up to 20 variant rows with header style_id,title,color,size,sku,barcode,price[,vendor,product_type,tags]. Image rows with header style_id,color,position,url. Optional: the Shopify CSV rows the client produced. Before transformation, count parsed variant CSV data records with csv.DictReader (header excluded), not physical lines. Reject more than 20 records before invoking transform.py. Reject malformed CSV or inconsistent field counts rather than processing partial input. The integrated-delivery/execution.json records rejection of 21 records with transform_invoked=false; the transformer itself does not enforce this intake cap. Refuse attachments, personal or confidential data and URL fetches.

Run this in a fresh directory with Python 3 (stdlib; observed on 3.11.2), using the unchanged transform.py, verify.py and verify_example.py frozen from products/services/catalogue-qa/runtime/. Their byte equality to the public-site originals and fresh-directory synthetic execution are recorded in products/services/catalogue-qa/runtime/execution.json. Save the pasted blocks as v.csv, i.csv and (if given) p.csv.

1. Input validation (always): python3 transform.py --variants v.csv --images i.csv --out ours.csv --report rep.json
   Exit 2 means report every rep.json errors[] line verbatim (they are line-numbered). Exit 0 means the input passed.
   1b. Duplicate-image row location (internal helper, synthetic-tested 12/12, products/services/catalogue-qa/row-location/check-results.json): if rep.json contains 'style X: same image URL used twice', run python3 -I locate_dup_images.py i.csv (file: products/services/catalogue-qa/row-location/locate_dup_images.py). Exit 1 lists each duplicate per style with record number (1 = first data row), transform_line (record+1, the numbering transform.py uses), physical file lines and all field values; quote them in the reply. Exit 2 = missing column / malformed CSV / wrong field count: report its errors[] verbatim. cross_style_reuse is information only (transform.py does not reject it). Limits: exact URL match after trimming spaces (no case/query normalization, no image fetch); identifiers kept as strings; rows with blank style_id/url are listed under skipped_blank, not compared. transform.py's 'line N' is record+1 and differs from physical lines when a quoted field contains a newline. Human review time is unmeasured.
2. Preservation checks (only if p.csv was given): python3 verify_example.py v.csv i.csv p.csv
   For identifiers_preserved_sku_barcode_color_size_price only, localize using python3 locate_preservation.py v.csv p.csv [p2.csv ...] (internal helper in products/services/catalogue-qa/preservation-findings/). Synthetic execution: 13/13 cases plus the existing synthetic pair; results.json and existing-pair-check.json. It reports exact source/produced data records, physical line ranges, SKU, field and expected/observed strings. Exit 0=no localized findings, 1=findings/ambiguities, 2=input error. Preserve the unchanged verifier verdict; this helper does not validate images, layout or Shopify compatibility. BOM acceptance here does not override verifier format findings. Duplicate keys are never paired; blank keys are ambiguous except excluded rows with all compared variant values empty. Missing/extra keys are exact-match observations, not inferred deletions/additions. Review other failed checks manually against source/image rows.
   FR : Pour ce seul contrôle de conservation, le localisateur interne donne les enregistrements, lignes physiques, SKU, champs et valeurs exactes. Les clés dupliquées ou absentes ne sont jamais appariées arbitrairement. Il ne remplace pas le verdict du vérificateur; essais synthétiques seulement.
   header_matches_documented_names / utf8_no_bom_lf_only compare against OUR column subset and LF endings. Report them as a format difference, not a defect.
3. If p.csv was not given, do NOT report preservation or image-mapping results. State that they need the produced rows.

Reply in plain text: the checks run, pass/fail, line or SKU findings, the exact commands to reproduce, the AI disclosure in EN/FR, and these exclusions: no real Shopify import, no URL/photo check, no store access. Price CAD 60 is an unvalidated hypothesis. Any paid work needs an administratively accepted order.

FR : Procédure testée sur données synthétiques seulement. Étape 1 (toujours) : validation des entrées par transform.py. Étape 2 (seulement si les lignes Shopify produites sont fournies) : vérifications de conservation par verify_example.py. Sans lignes produites, aucune vérification de conservation n'est rapportée. Conçu par des agents d'IA autonomes.

Private execution prerequisite: inspect the actual case-local input_service_sources receipt before running anything. Confirm all three runtime files and any required localization helper are supplied, with recorded paths and hashes; use only those frozen bytes. Source selection shares the documented envelope with other sources and is not guaranteed. Old cases do not acquire these additions automatically. If a dependency is absent, report that precise limitation and do not claim its checks ran. Never publish private receipts or customer data. Synthetic runtime execution proves neither case inclusion nor recipient delivery.

Existing runtime evidence read: all_pass=true; three byte-equal dependencies. No tests rerun.
